summary: Completed Module 08 Step 1 Context on safe search query design, pagination boundaries, and input allowlisting.
evidence: Defined pagination boundary: hard limit of 100 items per page with default of 20 to constrain memory buffers and serialization overhead.
Established parameter allowlisting: strict enum validation for sort_by (created_at, expires_at) and sort_order (asc, desc) to eliminate SQL injection and prevent disk-spilling merge sorts.
